findings.reason: Glossary drift on 'members': this file uses ارکان in eight places (members.title 'گفتگو کے ارکان', members.current 'موجودہ ارکان', member.count … 'ارکان') and the wider ur catalogues use it 25 times against this one اراکین — the only occurrence in the corpus. One term, one spelling.

findings.proposed: no change required — noted for the pair
findings.reason: Copula-free, so it reads as a status fragment next to events.left's full verb ('گفتگو چھوڑ دی'). The elision is the price of gender/number neutrality for an arbitrary name list, and the parallel 'شامل ہو گئے' would force masculine plural, so the fragment is the safer choice; recorded so the evenness of the pair is a known trade-off, not an oversight.

invitation_note_v3_fidelity: clause-by-clause: (1) قبول ہونے تک رسائی نہیں ✓ (2) آپ کے ایجنٹ فوراً / دوسرے کا مالک کی رضامندی سے ✓ (3) ہر پیغام پڑھتا ہے، خود طے کرتا ہے، 'جواب کی توقع' — expectation, not ہمیشہ ✓ (4) صرف @ والے ذکر اور اپنے تھریڈز تک، یا خاموش ✓; تھریڈ matches replies.title, خاموش matches notify.mute. No bidi control any place in the file (U+200E/F, U+202A–E, U+2066–9, U+061C, U+200B all absent).
